verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a REST API (the Lambda Cloud API) and a published OpenAPI spec. Neither is an official SDK; a REST API and a spec are developer building blocks from which an SDK could be generated. The only client tooling in the pack is an unofficial, community-built CLI and MCP server, which does not count as an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
